description: Employment and wages by industry (NAICS) for San Mateo County and Santa Clara County, California. Data from two sources: (1) BLS QCEW Open Data API providing federal QCEW data with location quotients and over-the-year changes, and (2) California EDD QCEW data from data.ca.gov with state-specific detail.

sources.name: BLS QCEW Open Data API
sources.notes: Federal QCEW data with full NAICS detail, location quotients, and over-the-year changes. Available for most recent 5 years.

sources.name: California EDD QCEW (data.ca.gov)
sources.notes: California EDD's own QCEW data with human-readable county names and industry names. Updated quarterly.

sources.name: EDD Open Data Portal
sources.notes: Portal landing page; actual datasets hosted on data.ca.gov and labormarketinfo.edd.ca.gov

ca_edd_san_mateo.csv.description: California EDD QCEW data for San Mateo County, all industries/ownership/NAICS levels, 2023-2025 Q3
ca_edd_san_mateo.csv.columns: Area Type, Area Name, Year, Time Period, Ownership, NAICS Level, NAICS Code, Industry Name, Establishments, Average Monthly Employment, 1st/2nd/3rd Month Emp, Total Wages, Avg Weekly Wages

ca_edd_santa_clara.csv.description: California EDD QCEW data for Santa Clara County, all industries/ownership/NAICS levels, 2023-2025 Q3

san_mateo_2024_annual.csv.description: BLS QCEW annual averages for San Mateo County (FIPS 06081), 2024
san_mateo_2024_annual.csv.columns: area_fips, own_code, industry_code, agglvl_code, size_code, year, qtr, disclosure_code, annual_avg_estabs, annual_avg_emplvl, total_annual_wages, taxable_annual_wages, annual_contributions, annual_avg_wkly_wage, avg_annual_pay, + location quotients + over-the-year changes

san_mateo_2023_annual.csv.description: BLS QCEW annual averages for San Mateo County, 2023

san_mateo_2024_q4.csv.description: BLS QCEW quarterly data for San Mateo County, 2024 Q4

san_mateo_2025_q1.csv.description: BLS QCEW quarterly data for San Mateo County, 2025 Q1

santa_clara_2024_annual.csv.description: BLS QCEW annual averages for Santa Clara County (FIPS 06085), 2024

santa_clara_2023_annual.csv.description: BLS QCEW annual averages for Santa Clara County, 2023

santa_clara_2024_q4.csv.description: BLS QCEW quarterly data for Santa Clara County, 2024 Q4

santa_clara_2025_q1.csv.description: BLS QCEW quarterly data for Santa Clara County, 2025 Q1

summary_by_industry_2024_annual.csv.description: Clean summary of 2024 annual employment by 2-digit NAICS industry, Private + Total Covered ownership, for both counties

information.note: Largest sector by wages, dominated by tech

notes: BLS QCEW uses FIPS codes: San Mateo = 06081, Santa Clara = 06085
CA EDD data uses human-readable county names and NAICS industry names
NAICS codes 10xx are BLS supersectors (aggregated categories), not standard NAICS
Some employment values show 0 in CA EDD data due to disclosure restrictions
Weekly wages are in dollars; annual wages are total (not per-worker)
BLS data includes location quotients relative to US and over-the-year changes
Most recent BLS quarterly data available is 2025 Q1; CA EDD has through 2025 Q3
